veyon_service_enabled.description: Whether the Veyon service is enabled to run.

veyon_service_path.description: Absolute path to the veyon-service binary.

veyon_private_key_path.description: Path to the RSA private key file for authentication.

veyon_public_key_path.description: Path to the RSA public key certificate file.

veyon_port.description: TCP port number for the Veyon service listener.

veyon_bind_address.description: Network interface address to bind the service to.

veyon_max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections.

veyon_log_path.description: File path for the service log.

veyon_syslog.description: Whether to log to the system syslog.

veyon_syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use when logging to syslog.

veyon_allow_remote_view.description: Allow remote users to view the local screen.

veyon_allow_remote_control.description: Allow remote users to control the local input devices.

veyon_allow_demo_mode.description: Allow the service to act as a target for screen broadcasting.

veyon_allow_lock_screen.description: Allow remote locking of the local display.

veyon_allow_remote_apps.description: Allow launching remote applications on the local machine.

veyon_allow_screenshot.description: Allow taking screenshots of the local screen.

veyon_allow_user_management.description: Allow remote user login and logout management.

veyon_allow_power_management.description: Allow remote shutdown and reboot commands.

veyon_computer_name.description: Identifier for this computer in the Veyon network.

veyon_tags.description: List of tags for the computer. Used as a comma-separated string in config.
